newsitem.title: FRANCE: DMC sees considerable drop in H2 result.
newsitem.headline: DMC sees considerable drop in H2 result.

text.p: French textiles group DMC said on Thursday it expected a considerable drop in its second-half result excluding exceptional charges due to falling sales.
The group noted in a statement that it reported a loss of 144 million francs for the first half of the year.

It said nine-month sales came in at 4.591 billion francs, down 14 percent on the same period in 1995, and said that a third quarter advance of 23 percent in sportswear material failed to make up for a 32 percent drop in printed fabric sales.
